page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. This instance features 48 dedicated virtual CPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced resource allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

The instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio offer a predictable performance profile for enterprise workloads without the overhead of bundled local storage or specialized GPU hardware.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and high network bandwidth, the ecs.g7ne.12xlarge is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and moderate database workloads that rely on network-attached storage.
